category.notFoundBody: It may have moved. Browse everything currently in the studio.
category.emptyBody: Pieces arrive here as the season lands. Browse everything in the meantime.
category.aboutBody: Every piece in this collection is graded on real bodies and cut from the same four colourways, so anything here works with anything else. Sizes run XS to XL, with denim and footwear in numeric sizing.

copy.women: Dresses, shirting, knitwear and outerwear cut for a full wardrobe rather than a single season.
copy.men: Shirting, jersey and knitwear in natural fibres, cut generous and made to be repeated.
copy.shoes: Vegetable-tanned leather on slim soles. Resolable, and built to soften with wear.
copy.bags: Structured leather and waxed canvas, sized for a day out and a weekend away.
copy.accessories: Steel, leather and glass. The small pieces that finish an outfit.
copy.lifestyle: Objects and printed matter for keeping a wardrobe in good condition.

meta.women: Womenswear from VAREL: dresses, shirts, knitwear, trousers, denim and outerwear in natural fibres.
